observations: Photo 0 shows four camshaft or timing gear assemblies and one larger gear assembly on concrete, plus a long shaft; seller's feet in sandals visible at bottom
Photo 1 shows two diesel fuel injection pumps with external control levers mounted on a wooden board
Photo 2 shows a hand holding two fuel injectors, with a sack containing many more used injectors in the background
All three photos carry a watermark reading "CHIDO MOTOR"
No readable brand, model, or part numbers are visible on any item in any photo

identity.kind: used engine parts (camshaft assemblies, fuel injection pumps, fuel injectors)

claims.claim: We sale all types of Toyota engine parts such as Corolla Camry sienna land cruiser fj cruiser Lexus...
claims.evidence: No Toyota or Lexus branding visible in photos 0, 1, or 2; seller text alone cannot be verified remotely

risks.risk: Parts may not fit the buyer's specific Toyota or Lexus model
risks.proof: Clear photos of stamped part numbers on each unit, or a fitment list matched to a VIN

risks.risk: Internal condition cannot be confirmed from external photos
risks.proof: Bench test video showing rotation, plunger movement, or compression

risks.risk: Fuel injectors and pumps may be clogged, worn, or damaged internally
risks.proof: Injector flow or spray pattern video, or pump bench test
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap or core only

risks.risk: Items may be aftermarket rather than genuine Toyota parts
risks.proof: Close-up of Toyota casting marks, logos, or part numbers
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket or unknown origin

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any stamped part numbers on the camshaft assemblies, injection pumps, and injectors
Video of the injection pumps being rotated or bench-tested
Video of injector spray pattern or flow test
Clear photos showing any Toyota or Lexus branding on the castings
response.reason: The items are identifiable as used engine parts by type, so they can be priced at worst case (non-working) while awaiting proof of condition, fitment, and authenticity.
